commands.review_summary:
The branch replaces the single manual refresh task with scoped global/provider refresh tasks, updates menu-card refresh monitoring and shutdown/menu tracking, and rewrites refresh-row tests.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main uses one manualRefreshTask to both disable Refresh rows and block subsequent manual refreshes. I did not run UI or tests because this review is read-only.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The PR needs the contributor to fix the frozen-model merge and provide convincing real behavior proof; ClawSweeper should not queue a repair marker while proof remains insufficient.

target.title: fix: scope refresh-row disabling to the provider being refreshed
target.body: ## Problem Clicking Refresh (or ⌘R) in one provider's menu disables the "Refresh" row for *every* provider, not just the one being refreshed. In unmerged mode each provider's own menu shows a greyed row; in merged mode switching tabs shows the same. Since only the clicked provider actually refreshes, the greyed rows imply work that isn't happening. The manual-refresh path was also globally single-flight, so a second provider's refresh was silently dropped while the first was in flight. ## Cause `isRefreshActionInFlight(for:)` returned early on `manualRefreshTask != nil`, and `startManualRefresh(for:)` guarded on that same single global task. Both were provider-agnostic, even though the store already tracks refreshes per provider via `refreshingProviders`. ## Change - Replace the single `manualRefreshTask` (plus the write-only `manualRefreshProvider`) with `manualRefreshTasks: [ManualRefreshScope: Task]`, where `ManualRefreshScope` is `.global` (the all-providers ⌘R / merged-overview refresh) or `.provider(p)`. - The disable gate now reflects only the target provider's own refresh. A `.global` refresh still disables every row, and merged-overview keeps mirroring the global busy state. - `startManualRefresh` guards per scope, so different providers refresh concurrently instead of blocking each other. The store already supported this (`refreshingProviders` is a set); only the controller serialized it. - `MenuCardRefreshMonitor` tracks in-flight providers as a set plus a global flag, so the "Refreshing…" subtitle and frozen-layout freeze stay scoped per provider. `manualRefreshTask` is kept as a thin computed accessor used only by tests. ## Tests Rewrote the refresh-row tests that asserted the old blanket behavior (for example, that refreshing Claude greyed the Codex row) to the scoped semantics, and added two: refreshing one provider leaves another's row enabled, and a second provider can start refreshing while the first is in flight. `StatusMenuPersistentRefreshTests`, `StatusMenuSwitcherRefreshTests`, and `StatusMenuMergedOverviewRefreshTests` pass (48 tests). 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) when refreshing claude code, other providers like cursor should not been put into grey:
